sacsayhuaman.name: Sacsayhuamán — fortress / park gate (walk origin)
sacsayhuaman.summary: Documented Inca/Killke cyclopean walls above Cusco. Sorcerers of Stone (yt-nN2oeAzpAt8) start at the main gate and walk ~45 min NW through pine/eucalyptus to the Quespehuara huacas. Fortress is real; the forest huacas are a separate pin.

quespehuara-huacas.name: Quespehuara / Qhespewara — forest huacas (soft-stone scoops)
quespehuara-huacas.summary: Sorcerers of Stone: fingerprint scoops, pulled-soft ledges, puma-paw niches in metamorphosed limestone ~45 min NW of Sacsayhuamán. Site exists inside the park (Quespewara / Qhespewara). Mainstream: Inca/Killke/Wari tools. Channel: geopolymer or stone-softening. GPS is region — walk-time lock, not a surveyed point.
claims: Fingerprint / scoop marks in hard metamorphosed limestone

coricancha-cusco.name: Coricancha — Qorikancha (puma-paw comparison)
coricancha-cusco.summary: Inca sun temple under Santo Domingo. Video cites the giant puma-paw carving here as a size-variant of the Quespehuara paw niches (geopolymer-stamp analogy). Temple is real; the stamp reading is overlay.
claims: Giant puma paw compared to Quespehuara niches

ollantaytambo-sun-temple.name: Ollantaytambo — Temple of the Sun / polygonal granite
ollantaytambo-sun-temple.summary: Sorcerers of Stone (yt-rxXLg_-a1wY): rose-granite polygonal walls, scoop trains on Mohs ~7–8 faces, resonant niches. Site is real Inca/earlier fabric. Channel: stone-softening + pre-Inca Hanan Pacha. Sister to Quespehuara (same school). Cross-school Venn with Egypt granite marks.
claims: Scoop marks down granite block faces
Named with Sacsayhuamán / Puma Punku as the three mega-sites

sources.label: Sorcerers of Stone — Ollantaytambo deep dive (video)

ollantaytambo-tired-stones.name: Piedras cansadas — tired / lazy stones (west approach)
ollantaytambo-tired-stones.summary: Local name for abandoned rose-granite megaliths on the roadway. Video: one ~80 t block the transport ministry paved around; pits, through-channel, nub. Official: men + rope + logs from Kachiqhata across the Vilcanota. Channel cites UnchartedX log-crush. GPS is region (roadside scatter).
claims: ~80 t rose granite left in the road

sources.label: Sorcerers of Stone — Ollantaytambo deep dive (video)

kachiqhata-quarry.name: Kachiqhata — rose-granite quarry (south of Vilcanota)
kachiqhata-quarry.summary: Documented source of Ollantaytambo’s rose granite. Video: tired stones came down the mountain and across the river. Crossing + log-sled story is the rabbit-hole physics; the quarry itself is not in dispute.
claims: Source of the rose granite / tired stones

sources.label: Sorcerers of Stone — Ollantaytambo deep dive (video)

apurimac-source-mismi.name: Apurímac source — Nevado Mismi / Apacheta
apurimac-source-mismi.summary: thePOVchannel (yt-v3DlKLkb5KM) hiked the origin of the Apurímac (longest Amazon tributary; Quechua Apu Rímac ≈ ‘where the lord speaks’) then worked downstream. Source peak/ridge is a documented hydrology claim (Mismi / Apacheta), not a lost city.
claims: Hiked the Apurímac origin before the downstream forts

sources.label: thePOVchannel — lost city of the Amazon (video)

apurimac-headwaters-mesas.name: Apurímac headwaters mesas — 14k-ft defensive complex
apurimac-headwaters-mesas.summary: Video: volcanic-rock basin where three streams meet; mesa-top ruins, circular funerary towers, alpaca-hoof stairs, Wari roads; ‘≥3× Machu Picchu.’ 2023 Emerson Pereira temple/fountain cited. Site cluster is real-class (high-puna Wari/Inca) but this pin is not a surveyed hectare. GPS region only.

sources.label: thePOVchannel — lost city of the Amazon (video)

choquequirao.name: Choquequirao — ‘sister’ of Machu Picchu / Enc Kagua overlay
choquequirao.summary: Documented Inca complex above the Apurímac. Video: 2019 royal metal ornaments; packaged as Cieza’s lost fortress ‘Enc Kagua’ (name not locked). No Spanish siege kit found — absence-signal, not a verdict. Last-refuge contrast is usually Vilcabamba.
claims: Enc Kagua / Cieza overlay; no Spanish trace

sources.label: thePOVchannel — lost city of the Amazon (video)

qeswachaka-bridge.name: Q’eswachaka — last Inca grass-rope bridge
qeswachaka-bridge.summary: Last annually rebuilt ichu-grass Inca bridge. Video walks the drive to it (and into Chiaraje). Living practice, not a lost-tech overlay.
claims: Last true Inca rope bridge; rebuilt yearly

sources.label: thePOVchannel — lost city of the Amazon (video)

chiaraje-canas.name: Chiaraje — living ritual battle (Canas / Espinar)
chiaraje-canas.summary: Annual inter-ayllu battle. Video: driver stumbled into it on the Q’eswachaka road — car kicked, swinging machete/mace; later IDs Chiaraje. Documented ethnography. Channel rhyme: the mesa-fort wars never fully stopped. GPS region (moves by year/communities).
claims: Living territorial battle; outsiders get hit

sources.label: thePOVchannel — lost city of the Amazon (video)

monte-sierpe-band-of-holes.name: Monte Sierpe — Band of Holes (Pisco Valley)
monte-sierpe-band-of-holes.summary: Uncharted Mysteries (yt-z1wmPLosRHU): ~5,000+ stone-lined pits in a mile-long hillside grid. Not graves (empty), not cisterns (sand drains). From the air a barcode. Contrast: 2025 Sydney/Cambridge drone work argues accounting/exchange, not a machine. Category-gap is the empty grid.
claims: Aerial grid / barcode over a mile

puma-punku.name: Puma Punku — andesite H-blocks (Tiwanaku)
puma-punku.summary: Uncharted Mysteries: modular andesite H-blocks with sharp inside right angles; sandstone platform. Tiwanaku, usually ~6th c. Channel: assembly-line / no chisel radius. Real site. Plastic-stone Venn with Egypt granite and Ollantaytambo scoops — overlap ≠ one factory.
claims: H-blocks as modular interchangeable parts (Megalithic Vault)
